palaisidealcheval.name: Palais Idéal
palaisidealcheval.slogan: A postman's dream, built stone by stone on his mail round.
palaisidealcheval.line: I said to myself: since Nature is willing to do the sculpture, I will do the masonry and the architecture.
palaisidealcheval.by: Ferdinand Cheval, on building the Palais Idéal

grenoblebulles.name: Bastille Cable Car
grenoblebulles.slogan: Glass bubbles lifting you over the Isère and into the Alps.
grenoblebulles.line: Grenoble's egg-shaped cabins, nicknamed 'the bubbles', have linked the city to the Bastille since 1934.

voironchartreusecellars.name: Caves de la Chartreuse
voironchartreusecellars.slogan: Where monks' green liqueur ages in vast oak cellars.
voironchartreusecellars.line: Only two monks know the secret recipe, said to use 130 herbs, plants and flowers.

briancoincitevauban.name: Cité Vauban, Briançon
briancoincitevauban.slogan: France's highest city, ringed by Vauban's star-shaped ramparts.
briancoincitevauban.line: At about 1,326 m, Briançon is France's highest city; its Vauban fortifications joined UNESCO World Heritage in 2008.

museedegrenoble.name: Musée de Grenoble
museedegrenoble.slogan: Matisse, Picasso and Old Masters at the foot of the Alps.
museedegrenoble.line: Founded in 1798, it was France's leading museum of modern art from about 1920 into the early 1950s under curator Andry-Farcy.
